From your PokerCoaching charts (12bb effective, 8-max, 1bb big-blind ante). Chip EV: on the bubble, call tighter. 90 charts.

All in (shove or re-jam)Min-raise / raiseCall (or check)FoldSplit cells are mixed: the chart plays each action that share of the time.

Opening: folded to you

Shove (dark red) or min-raise (red). Min-raise your strongest hands so they get action; shove the middle hands that win most when everyone folds. Small blind: no 12bb open chart; it plays limp/shove (see BB vs SB limp for the big blind side).

Facing a UTG min-raise

Re-jam all in (dark red), call (green) or fold. Percentages are shares of all hands.

Calling an open-shove (12bb)

Green = call the all-in; everything else folds. Call wider against later-position shoves, whose ranges are wider.

You min-raised and got re-jammed

Only the hands you min-raised appear (white = not in your min-raise range). Green = call the re-jam.

Big blind vs the small blind

BB facing an SB limp: shove, raise or check. BB facing an SB shove: call or fold.
